title: DeepSeek Harness — Put a desktop AI agent in your pocket
text: DeepSeek Harness — 把电脑上的 AI Agent，装进你的手机
DeepSeek Harness — Put a desktop AI agent in your pocket
桌面引擎 × 手机遥控
桌面引擎 × 手机遥控 · 开源免费
Desktop engine × phone remote · free and open source
把电脑上的 AI Agent，装进你的手机。
Put a desktop AI agent on your phone.
DeepSeek Harness 是跑在你电脑上的 AI 干活引擎：文件、终端、浏览器都归它管； 手机配对后，人在外面也能指挥它——发任务、看进度、取文件。

DeepSeek Harness is a do-the-work AI engine running on your own computer, with direct control of your files, terminal and browser. Pair your phone once and you can run it from anywhere — send tasks, watch progress, collect the files.
任务在电脑执行 · 会话与密钥留在本机
Work runs on your desktop · sessions and keys stay on your machine
Windows 10+ · Android 8+ · 国内直连下载 · 免费开源
Windows 10+ · Android 8+ · direct download in China · free and open source
朱泉制作的社区项目 · 非 DeepSeek 官方产品
A community project by Quan Zhu · not an official DeepSeek product
一方天地 · 尽在掌中
A whole world in your palm
If you like it, drop a
* 调用在线模型时，会向所选服务商发送完成任务所需的内容；异地连接会经过中继转发。存储与传输是两件事，这里都说清楚。
* Calling an online model sends what it needs to the provider you picked, and remote connections are relayed. Storage and transmission are two different things — both are stated plainly here.
它不是「又一个聊天客户端」
聊天客户端让你和模型说话；DeepSeek Harness 让你把活交出去——
A chat client lets you talk to a model. DeepSeek Harness lets you hand the work over.
The work happens on your computer
文件、终端、浏览器都在本机执行。它真的会动手干活，不是嘴上说说。
Files, terminal, browser — all executed locally. It actually does the work instead of talking about it.
配对码 10 秒连上。发任务、看进度、收文件——人不在电脑前，活照常干。
Pair in about ten seconds. Send tasks, watch progress, collect files — the work carries on while you’re away from the desk.
不用注册云账号。手机与电脑直接配对通信，会话、文件与密钥保存在你自己的电脑上。
No cloud account. Your phone talks straight to your computer, and sessions, files and keys live there.
下载安装，配好你的模型
Download it and point it at your model
Scan the QR code or type the pair code
十秒内连上自己的电脑
Connected to your own computer in seconds
Send from the phone, run on the desktop
Results land back on your phone
遥控时需要已配对的电脑保持运行并可连接；断线后会自动重连。
Remote control needs the paired computer up and reachable; dropped connections reconnect automatically.
她是配套的控制器：配对一次，随时回来接着用。
A companion controller: pair once, pick up right where you left off.
配对码或扫码连接；同一 Wi-Fi 直连，异地自动走中继
Pair with a code or a scan. On the same Wi-Fi it connects directly; off-network it falls back to the relay.
顶栏实时三态：已连接 / 正在连接 / 未连接，心里有数
Live status in the top bar — connected, connecting, offline. Always know where you stand.
任务进度、思考过程、生成的文件，手机上全程可见
Progress, the model’s reasoning and the files it generates stay visible on the phone throughout.
不在电脑前也能插话、排队、叫停
Chime in, queue another task or stop it — without being at the desk.
是会陪你干活的看板娘
a mascot who hangs around while you work
这是手机端花心思最多的部分——她不是装饰，她有自己的小情绪。
This is where the mobile app put the most care. She isn’t decoration — she has moods of her own.
网页互动演示 · 点她试试——App 里她真的会跟着任务变情绪，悬浮球双击还能摸头。
Interactive demo — give her a tap. In the app she really does change mood with your tasks, and double-tapping the floating bubble pets her.
聊天页、模型页、网络路由，手机上一站式管理（作用于桌面端引擎的模型请求）。
Chat, models and network routing managed in one place on your phone (applies to the desktop engine’s model requests).
支持兼容接口的服务商：DeepSeek、Claude、GPT、国内中转……（能力取决于服务与模型）
Any API-compatible provider: DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Chinese relays… (what you get depends on the service and the model)
「代理 / 直连」按服务商单独设——必须走代理的、必须直连的，互不打架
Proxy or direct, set per provider — the ones that must tunnel and the ones that must go straight stop fighting each other
上游清单有更新？一键同步服务商提供的模型清单
Upstream list changed? Sync the provider’s model list in one tap
电脑端官方登录 / 官方 API key 的模型也会列出来，标为「只读」——能选、能当默认，但删不掉也改不坏
Models from the desktop’s official sign-in or official API key show up too, marked read-only: you can pick them and make them the default, but you can’t delete or break them
配置示例，以你的网络环境为准
Example config — your network may differ
干活过程与成果都在两端无缝流转。
The work and its output flow between both ends without friction.
图形 / 网页预览，居中呈现；代码可复制、可存成文件
Charts and web previews render centred; code can be copied or saved as a file
会话生成的文件按会话归属，点开即看
Files are grouped by session — tap to open
桌面端是完整工作台：3.3 万+ 插件市场、皮肤、多会话并行
The desktop is the full workbench: a 33,000+ plugin market, skins, parallel sessions
和你用过的那些，不太一样
Not quite like what you’ve used
不做贬低式对比，只讲机制差异；「普通聊天客户端」指典型形态，不代表每一家都如此。
No trash talk — just how the mechanics differ. “Typical chat client” describes the usual shape, not every product.
在云端运行，接触不到你本机的文件
In the cloud, with no access to your local files
你自己的电脑：文件、终端、浏览器
Your own computer: files, terminal, browser
另一个独立客户端，与桌面互不相通
A separate client, disconnected from the desktop
通常需要账号登录与云同步
Usually means a login and cloud sync
视网络情况，有时需要代理
Whale Girl: moods, a floating bubble,
Pick your build and get to work
自动识别当前设备并高亮推荐；全部安装包也可以在
We detect your device and highlight the right build. Every installer is also on the
快捷方式、开始菜单项一步到位；还有
Shortcuts and Start-menu entries handled for you; there’s also a
骁龙 X 等 ARM 处理器的笔记本
Snapdragon X and other ARM laptops
M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 芯片
树莓派 / ARM 服务器
Android 8.0+ · 与电脑端配对使用
Android 8.0+ · pairs with the desktop app
安装包发布也在这里 · 欢迎 Star
Installers ship from here too · stars welcome
下载不动？试试「直连加速」链接，或挂上代理走 GitHub Releases。每个版本都附更新日志与哈希校验。
Download crawling? Try the direct-acceleration link, or reach GitHub Releases through a proxy. Every release ships changelog notes and a hash.
最近几个版本，更新了这些
What the last few releases changed
手机上只看见你说的话
Only your own words on the phone
引擎每回合会把运行环境、技能目录、时间快照当成「用户消息」重放进历史，手机端原来一律渲染成你发的——气泡里全是大段英文机器文本，你自己的提问反而被淹掉

Each turn the engine replays the runtime environment, the skill list and a time snapshot into history as “user” messages. The phone rendered all of that as yours, so bubbles filled with machine boilerplate and your own question got buried.
现在只显示真人发言（旧历史没有来源标记的照常显示）；实测一次手机发起的长任务，4 条用户消息只渲染 1 条，工具调用与结果不受影响
Now only real messages show (older history without source tags renders as before). On a long phone-initiated task, 4 user entries collapsed to the 1 real one; tool calls and results are untouched.
本次改内置 mobile-bridge 插件（0.2.48），手机 App 无需更新
Touches the bundled mobile-bridge plugin (0.2.48); the phone app needs no update.
思考不串味，档位按线路走
Mistral 这类严格服务商开启思考后返回的是块数组，正文不会再显示成
Strict providers like Mistral return reasoning as block arrays; the message no longer renders as
；桌面端启动时自动给引擎打兼容补丁，引擎升级后自动重打，打不中只记日志不挡启动
. The desktop patches the engine for compatibility at launch, re-applies it after engine upgrades, and only logs a miss rather than blocking startup.
「从上游同步模型」不再 30 秒超时——桥接改走引擎自己的代理调度器后，实测 Mistral 返回 64 个模型
“Sync models from upstream” no longer times out at 30s — the bridge now uses the engine’s own proxy dispatcher, and Mistral returns 64 models in testing.
思考档位可以按线路单独覆盖：同一个模型在 A 家支持 6 档、B 家只支持 4 档时，同步后不会再被写回上游不支持的档位
Reasoning effort can be overridden per route: when the same model offers 6 levels at provider A but only 4 at B, a sync no longer writes back levels the upstream rejects.
稳定入口，官方模型上手机
Stable entry, official models on mobile
配对二维码与链接固定给稳定入口（Cloudflare 隧道，进同一台中继）：此前给直连地址时，部分手机在 TLS 握手前被掐断，App 每次启动都提示「建议重新配对」——换入口后不再出现

Pairing QR codes and links now use a stable entry point (a Cloudflare tunnel into the same relay). The old direct address was cut before the TLS handshake on some phones, so the app asked you to re-pair on every launch. That prompt is gone.
手机端能看到引擎自己管理的提供商模型（官方账号登录、官方 API key），标为「只读」：不显示编辑 / 删除，任何写回官方配置的提交都会被丢弃，不会写坏电脑端设置

The phone lists models from providers the engine manages itself (official sign-in, official API key), marked read-only: no edit or delete, and any write-back into the official config is discarded, so desktop settings can’t be corrupted.
网页版（PWA）切换模型不再只列前 60 条；中继日志追加 via=direct / via=cf，一条日志就能看出手机走的是直连还是隧道。直连 8443 与 443 都保留可用

Switching models in the web app (PWA) no longer stops at the first 60 entries. Relay logs now tag via=direct / via=cf, so a single line tells you whether the phone went direct or through the tunnel. Direct ports 8443 and 443 both stay available.
官方 DeepSeek 模型，直接选
模型列表会列出电脑端正用着的提供商——官方账号登录、官方 API key 都在内，可直接切换或设为新对话默认
The model list includes the providers your desktop already uses — official sign-in and official API key among them — ready to switch to or set as the default for new chats.
这些提供商在模型页标为「只读」，不会误删或写坏电脑端配置
They’re marked read-only, so they can’t be deleted by accident or damage your desktop config.
思考强度补上「关」，默认档位跟随引擎；修复模型菜单把第一档误当默认的问题
Reasoning effort gained an “off” step, the default follows the engine, and the model menu no longer mistakes the first level for the default.
冷灰与蓝色统一跨端配色，深浅主题跟随系统；文字、按钮和代码具有清晰对比度
Cool grey and blue unify both apps, light and dark follow the system, and text, buttons and code all keep clear contrast.
首页增加继续会话和状态筛选，标题、摘要、时间与附件分层，代码和表格只显示短提示
The home screen gained resume-session and status filters; title, summary, time and attachments are layered, and code and tables collapse to short hints.
相同列表请求在途时共享结果，减少重复刷新；窄屏与大字体下状态文字完整显示
Duplicate list requests share one in-flight result, cutting refreshes; status text stays legible on narrow screens and with large fonts.
：内置 3.3 万+ 插件目录（多源聚合、每日自动更新、安全标注），支持分类筛选、热度 / 星标 / 最新 / 下载排序与分页浏览
: a built-in catalogue of 33,000+ plugins (multi-source, refreshed daily, safety-tagged) with category filters, sorting by popularity / stars / recency / downloads, and paging
「AI 帮我选」与「今日日报」：一句话描述需求，AI 从全库挑出合适插件并附推荐理由；日报每天汇总插件生态动态
“Let AI pick” and a daily digest: describe what you need in one sentence and AI shortlists plugins with reasons; the digest rounds up the ecosystem every day.
「连不上」一键定位：连接失败时错误信息自动附带引擎诊断——试过的接口、引擎与桥接版本、可用服务清单
One-tap diagnosis for “can’t connect”: failures now carry engine diagnostics — endpoints tried, engine and bridge versions, available services.
ends up in the next release
这个项目由一个人开发维护，每一条反馈作者都会看。
One person builds and maintains this, and reads every piece of feedback.
崩溃、卡住、下载不动？把版本和现象发过来。
Crashes, freezes, stalled downloads — send the version and what happened.
想让它多会点什么？说说你的使用场景。
Want it to do more? Tell me about your workflow.
不会用、想看看别人怎么玩，来讨论区坐坐。
Stuck, or curious how others use it? Drop by the discussions.

这是 DeepSeek 官方软件吗？
不是。这是社区项目，由个人开发者制作。核心引擎使用官方 npm 包
No. It’s a community project by an individual developer. The core engine is the official npm package
，桌面端与手机端是围绕它做的配套客户端；与 DeepSeek 公司没有隶属关系。
, and the desktop and mobile apps are companion clients built around it. It is not affiliated with DeepSeek.
Is it free? Is it open source?
客户端免费。桌面端与手机端源码都在
The clients are free. Both desktop and mobile sources live on
上公开；模型费用由你使用的服务商收取（用自己的 API Key）。
; model usage is billed by whichever provider you point it at, with your own API key.
全部在你自己的电脑上：会话、生成的文件、密钥都在本机。没有云账号，手机只是通过配对的加密通道遥控电脑，
Entirely on your own computer: sessions, generated files and keys all stay local. There’s no cloud account — the phone only drives that computer over a paired encrypted channel, and
不经过我们的任何服务器存储
nothing is stored on any server of ours
手机和电脑怎么连？需要公网 IP 吗？
How do the phone and desktop connect? Do I need a public IP?
不需要。同一 Wi-Fi 下直接局域网连接；不在同一网络时自动走中继（含国内直连节点）。配对码或扫码即可完成。
No. On the same Wi-Fi they connect over the LAN; on different networks it falls back to the relay, including China-based nodes. A pair code or a QR scan is all it takes.
App Store 上没有。手机上目前是 Android APK；iPhone 可用网页版（PWA，用 Safari 打开电脑端给出的手机入口后「添加到主屏幕」），iOS 源码也已公开，可自行编译。Windows 电脑端 + 任意手机浏览器是最省事的一组。

There’s no App Store build. The phone app ships as an Android APK; on iPhone use the web app — open the mobile link the desktop gives you in Safari, then “Add to Home Screen”. The iOS source is public if you’d rather build it. Easiest combo: the Windows desktop app plus any phone browser.
插件市场里到底有多少插件？
How many plugins are in the market?
（其中可一键安装的约 3 万条），覆盖界面美化、主题皮肤、模型接入、工作流、工具增强、记忆检索、安全等 11 类，每天 04:30 重建一次。目录也可以直接在浏览器里翻：

(about 30,000 one-click installable), across 11 categories — UI, themes, model providers, workflow, tools, memory and search, security and more — rebuilt daily at 04:30. You can also browse it in a browser:
任何兼容 OpenAI / Anthropic 接口的服务商都可以接进来：DeepSeek 官方、Claude、GPT、以及国内各家 API 中转。每家公司还能单独设「代理 / 直连」路由。电脑端自己管理的官方登录 / 官方 API key 模型也会出现在手机上（标「只读」，不会被手动修改覆盖）。

Any provider speaking the OpenAI or Anthropic API: official DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, and Chinese API relays. Each gets its own proxy/direct route. Models from the desktop’s official sign-in or official API key also appear on the phone, marked read-only so manual edits can’t overwrite them.
它和 Cherry Studio、Chatbox 这类客户端有什么不同？
How is this different from Cherry Studio or Chatbox?
那些是「聊天客户端」——你和模型对话。DeepSeek Harness 是「干活引擎 + 遥控器」——任务在你电脑上真实执行（能碰文件、能跑命令），你用手机在外面指挥它、看进度、取结果。两者可以共存，但解决的问题不一样。

Those are chat clients — you talk to a model. DeepSeek Harness is a work engine plus a remote: tasks really execute on your computer (touching files, running commands) while you direct it, watch progress and collect results from your phone. They can coexist; they solve different problems.
桌面端启动时自动检查新版本；手机端在「设置 → 检查更新」里升级；官网提供当前最新版本。更新过程中你的数据与配置都会保留。
The desktop checks for updates at launch; the phone app updates under Settings → Check for updates; this site always carries the latest build. Your data and settings survive an update.
Who do I ask when something breaks?
上面反馈区的三个入口作者都会看。报告问题时附上：系统版本、软件版本、复现步骤，有截图更好。
The author reads all three channels in the feedback section above. Include your OS version, app version and steps to reproduce — a screenshot helps.
电脑端和手机端是配套的，两个都装上才是完整体验。
The desktop and phone apps are a pair — install both for the full experience.
跑在你自己电脑上的 AI Agent 引擎，配一只随时待命的手机遥控器和一位会撒娇的鲸鱼娘。
An AI agent engine that runs on your own computer, a phone remote that’s always standing by, and a Whale Girl who likes a head pat.
